title: Questions I get about running agents

entries.question: Do agents replace PMs?
entries.answer: No. They raise the ceiling on what a sharp PM can ship, and the floor on what an unsharp one can get away with.

entries.question: Which model is best?
entries.answer: The one whose failure modes you understand. Fluency is cheap; knowing where it lies is the skill.

entries.question: How do you review agent PRs?
entries.answer: Read the test first. If the acceptance test matches the spec, the diff is usually trivial to approve.
